name: Vision Screening Certification for New Students
description: Before first admission, parents present certification that the child passed/failed a qualified vision screening or had a comprehensive eye exam within the past twelve months.
deadline: prior to admission to school for the first time
quote: Prior to admission to school for the first time, a student's parent/ guardian shall present to the District certification from a primary care provider or vision screener that their child has passed or failed a vision screening performed by a primary care provider
